name: FaceBlur
tagline: Blur faces in video online. Keep the people you choose clear.
description: FaceBlur blurs faces in video online. Upload an MP4, MOV or WebM; every face is found and tracked automatically. Tap the people who should stay clear and blur, pixelate or black-box everyone else. Photos and Private mode—browser-only, the video never leaves your device—are free. Cloud mode is planned and not on sale yet.
